title: Ops Event (Gource-compatible + SeekLog semantics)
description: Thin, seekable, append-only ops event IR. Compatible with Gource custom log format and with existing ACTION-EFFECT-EVENT / EVIDENCE-ENVELOPE surfaces. Designed for agentic replay evaluations and process refinement. Visualization is optional and deferred.

ts.description: ISO 8601 or Unix epoch seconds (Gource accepts both)

actor.description: Agent, lane, user, or system identity (maps to Gource username)

path.description: Logical path: file, issue, PR, gate, catalog entry, Stepie milestone, etc.

colour.description: Optional Gource hex colour (encode lane, confidence, gate result)

lane.description: LANE-MATRIX lane id or short name

meta.description: Free-form bridge to ACTION-EFFECT-EVENT, EVIDENCE-ENVELOPE, dual-gate, help-wanted, etc.
